sections.label: Beyond the Eye
sections.heading: Beyond the Eye: A New Frontier in Detection
paragraphs: The retina is one of the only places in the body where microvascular and neural structures can be observed directly and noninvasively.
At Ophthalytics, we are advancing the field of oculomics—where retinal imaging extends beyond eye disease to reveal early indicators of systemic health.
By combining AI with multimodal data, we enable earlier risk detection, deeper clinical insights, and more connected care.
This is the future of preventive healthcare—starting with the eye.

flagship.heading: Ocula360
paragraphs: Ocula360 is our flagship AI engine designed to detect multiple retinal diseases from a single image. Built on a foundational model architecture, it enables scalable screening, advanced DRSS scoring, and future-ready multimodal applications.
From clinical workflows to research environments, Ocula360 transforms retinal imaging into actionable diagnostic intelligence.

highlight.heading: From one retinal image to scalable diagnostic intelligence.
highlight.body: Multi-disease detection, explainable AI outputs, DR severity support, and flexible deployment models for providers, payers, eye care, and global screening markets.

tiles.title: Multi-Disease Detection
tiles.body: Detects diabetic retinopathy, AMD, glaucoma indicators, and vascular abnormalities.
